Weed in Upper West Side

The Upper West Side has two licensed dispensaries with about 1,830 products combined, the deepest two-store neighborhood in the city. The Flowery's Upper West Side store on Broadway near 92nd Street lists more than 1,000 products, the third-largest menu in New York, and Superfly on West 86th Street near Columbus lists about 800. They are a ten-minute walk apart.

Pre-rolls lead at 555 listings, followed by 434 vapes, 405 flower options and 372 edibles, with 30 concentrates. The Flowery ties for the deepest Jaunty run in the city and carries strong Ayrloom, Florist Farms and Grön selections, and it is one of the better stops for Jetty Extracts and Camino. Superfly is the stronger flower and Dank By Definition shop and one of the few places carrying Good Tide and a deep Cannabals run. Prices start at $5 for drinks and drops at The Flowery and $9 for 5 Boro dime bags.

  • Pre-rolls (555), vapes (434) and flower (405) are all deep; edibles total 372.

Upper West Side FAQ
What is the largest dispensary on the Upper West Side?

The Flowery at 2465 Broadway near 92nd Street, with more than 1,000 products. Only Qube in Midtown and Twenty8gramz in Sheepshead Bay list more in our data.

Is Superfly worth visiting if The Flowery is bigger?

Yes if you want flower. Superfly lists a larger flower selection relative to its size and carries Dank By Definition, Cannabals and Good Tide deeply. The two menus overlap less than you would expect.

Can I bring cannabis into Central Park?

You can carry it, since the possession limit is three ounces, but you cannot smoke or vape in any New York City park. Edibles are the practical choice for a park day.
